note: Study-only reference register. Entries record what a fictional interface DID (palette relationship, hierarchy device, motion, interaction) so an analyst can study lineage. Nothing here is an asset for reuse. Every entry maps to a HELM language and carries an evidence class for its attribution claims. Typeface attributions for screen interfaces are UNCORROBORATED by policy.
